entries.06bfd531ac589e11: Centered on sales of Hall ICs, which are magnetic sensors, it also sells in-vehicle software and LED lighting products.
entries.797fd546a5a1a5e8: A specialized trading company with a coating business that sells paints, surface treatment agents, chemicals, and coating and measuring equipment and also undertakes painting work, and a business selling electronic components such as Hall ICs.
entries.8c44c9e5016a57ad: In addition to selling paints and surface treatment agents, chemical products and materials, and painting and measuring equipment, it undertakes construction work related to painting lines, interior and exterior renovation work on buildings, painting contracting, and color-matching processing of paints.
entries.ae65668353ba9245: The company, together with 15 consolidated subsidiaries, 1 unconsolidated subsidiary and 4 equity-method affiliates (21 companies in total), operates two businesses: the Coating-Related Business and the Electronics-Related Business (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.ca40b8727197d850: Centered on sales of Hall ICs, which are magnetic sensors, it also sells in-vehicle software and LED lighting products. As a specialized distributor of Hall ICs, it holds inventory at multiple locations in Japan and overseas and has built a structure enabling stable supply. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥20,407 million.
entries.dcb3df0a8fd48cfb: In addition to selling paints and surface treatment agents, chemical products and materials, and painting and measuring equipment, it undertakes construction work related to painting lines, interior and exterior renovation work on buildings, painting contracting, and color-matching processing of paints. The technical center at the Kanagawa office also develops coating film formation technologies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥47,861 million.
